notes.author: teddy0@arch-aftershock-rapid-glass-S267454
notes.content:
Flagged by the porting agent while landing gh-79 (annot_run.rs), deliberately out of scope
then. pdf_annot_transform (pdf-annot.c:194) builds a rotmat for annot rotate 90/180/270;
our port fixes rotmat = IDENTITY. Narrow real gap: a rotated page carrying a NoRotate annot
places that annot wrong. Everything else is unaffected. Upstream code is already vendored at
5fe54ce -- reuse the pin, do not re-check (AID-0056).

title: kopitiam-pdf: annotation /Rotate + NoRotate not handled (rotmat fixed at identity)

notes.author: teddy0@arch-aftershock-rapid-glass-S267454
notes.content:
Hit while landing gh-79. Regenerating on a machine with vendor/mupdf but WITHOUT the
pdf-to-markdown vendor tree: unported 19 -> 0, pdf-to-markdown 22 -> 3, total 162 -> 153.
The 9 new annotation ported rows were correct; the 19 vanished rows were pure loss, and the
determinism self-check STILL PASSED (deterministic given the same working tree, which is not
the property it claims). Regeneration reverted; ledger now stale w.r.t. the annotation port.
Provenance NOT lost: point-of-use headers + ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS record 5fe54ce (AID-0056).
Fix: fail loudly on a missing vendor tree rather than emitting a partial ledger.

title: scripts/port-ledger.sh silently drops unported rows when a vendor tree is absent
